exchanges: Morning! Coffee machine is broken at the office so I'm already off to a bad start.
That's a cruel way to begin the day. Is there a café nearby to save you?
yeah theres one across the street, the okafor twins are already over there lol
Sounds like the whole office had the same idea. Who are the Okafor twins?
chidi and chuka, theyre twins who both work here, chidi is one of our architects and chuka runs IT. people mix them up constantly
Identical twins in one office must cause some funny mix-ups.
so many. the easiest way to tell is football, chidi always wears his arsenal scarf in winter
A scarf is a handy cheat code. Does Chuka support the same team?
god no thats the whole thing, hes chelsea, they argue about it every monday morning
A built-in rivalry. Monday mornings must be lively after a big match.
ok so today is the big presentation for the ferreira residence. it's a full renovation of a 1920s house in the annex
Heritage renovations are always interesting. Who's the client?
Lucinda Ferreira, she's a retired surgeon, very sharp, asks hard questions. Rosa is leading the presentation, she's our senior architect.
A sharp client keeps everyone on their toes. Rosa sounds like the right person to lead.
rosa is amazing. she's a bit distracted today though, her husband tomas got called in for an emergency shift overnight, he's a pilot so its always last minute
Last-minute schedules like that are hard on a family. Hopefully she still got some sleep.
she says shes fine. ok presentation at 10, gotta prep the boards
Good luck, hope the boards come together.
the client loves the tile in the mockups btw, she's obsessed with azulejos. she grew up in Porto and wants the kitchen to feel like her grandmother's
That's a lovely personal touch to build around. Hand-painted tiles could be the centrepiece.
yeah rosa already sourced some from a supplier in toronto who imports them
Having a local source makes it much easier to plan around lead times.
ok going in now
You've got this!
That went really well. Lucinda asked about load-bearing walls for 20 minutes but Rosa handled it like a pro.
Sounds like a strong presentation. Did she approve the concept?
Mostly. She wants a second option for the back extension, something smaller.
That's reasonable feedback. A smaller version might also help her budget.
chidi will do the extension options, hes the best at small footprints
Good fit for the task. When does the client want to see them?
two weeks
That's a manageable turnaround for a couple of options.
lunch time. the twins are arguing about the weekend match again lol
Some traditions never die. Who won?
dont know dont care lol
Fair enough, stay out of the crossfire.
Oh I had something wrong this morning. Rosa's husband isn't a pilot, he's a firefighter. I think I mixed it up because he's always on overnight shifts. She laughed at me.
Easy to mix up with those unpredictable shifts. At least she found it funny.
she did. she said he would love to fly planes though lol
Ha, maybe a career change in his future.
ok afternoon slump hitting hard
Post-lunch slump is real. A short walk might help.
theres a new intern starting today too, yuki, im supposed to show her around
That might wake you up a bit. What's she going to work on?
drafting mostly, she just finished her masters
Fresh graduates bring a lot of energy. She'll learn fast with real projects.
showed her around. she seems nice, a bit shy
First days are overwhelming. Shy usually fades after a week or two.
chuka set up her laptop, he was weirdly chatty, i think he likes her lol
Office gossip in the making! Hopefully it doesn't get awkward.
lol we'll see
Time will tell.
she showed me her sketchbook, she does japanese calligraphy as a hobby and the brush work is honestly beautiful
That's a lovely skill, and it probably carries over into her drawing. Steady hands are useful in drafting.
for sure. ok I need to start on the meeting notes from this morning
Good idea while it's fresh in your mind.
ugh fine. writing them now
You'll feel better once they're done.

questions.message: what club is the IT twin a fan of again
rosas husband is a pilot isnt he
what does yuki do for fun
which football team does yuki support
my eyes are glazing over already, this is gonna take forever
